Authorized officers and permittees currently navigate disturbance events through case-by-case [...] would codify a surcharge for authorized leasing of livestock; and would streamline the Eastern State's competitive bidding process by removing the current 10-percent bid deposit requirement. In the aggregate, the proposed rule is expected to reduce barriers to entry for beginning and small business ranchers by prioritizing them for available forage and by providing opportunities to phase into securing a term grazing permit, a process that better aligns with modern economic constraints [...] Prioritizing beginning ranchers and mentees for newly available capacity may place other qualified applicants behind those categories in prospectus order.
